title: Vybuchit (Explosives)
description: This mod adds new explosive minerals
body:
This is WIP mod that adds new ore called "Rozryvit", new liquid called "Stabilite". Upon mixing them together, you get new highly explosive material called "Vybuchit". 

![A picture of some items added by the mod ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e64f5a282c5a0babd47dd2439698f78eed1c82a_0.webp)


Rozryvit ore can be found in Nether

Stabilite lakes can be found underground in Overworld

New blocks:
- landmine
- Rozryvit block
- Rozryvit ore
- Vybuchit block
- Vybuchit bomb
- Vybuchit mega bomb
- Explosive crafting table trap

It is recomended to use mods like JEI

Supported languages:
- English (US)
- Ukrainian 


This mod was made with Mcreator
